name: wx-trash-slot
title: Trash Slot
author: mtopfox
description: A trash slot attached to your inventory (port of the Minecraft mod TrashSlot). Hover a stack and press Delete to throw it in; the next delete destroys what was there (one undo brings the last destroyed stack back). Shift+Delete throws in every stack of that item. Click the slot to take it back, Delete on it destroys it. The slot sits beside the window or floats anywhere; with FSE, drag it. Safe to add or remove at any time.
